card.name: Small linking words mid-sentence
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as be, same, on, that, want and since, placed mid-sentence in general web text. It often follows a verb or noun about circulation, institutions, or availability.

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: A small connecting word such as that, same, since or on follows a noun or verb phrase.

modes.label: URL pieces
modes.description: Parts of web addresses such as :// or .amazon appear inside a link.

card.writes: The suppressed words relate to selling and pricing, so it may lower the chance of sales or price wording coming next.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in ordinary sentences, with no one clear meaning.
